Theorem
[Perelman's differential Harnack estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0362, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0364 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-adjoint-heat-kernel 1. ch16:16.44\group Perelman Harnack

For every Ricci flow on a closed manifold and its adjoint heat kernel, \[ v_H\le 0,\qquad au (R+2\Delta f-| abla f|^2)+f-n\le 0. \] Moreover, for any positive adjoint heat solution $u$, \[ \left(\partial _ au -\Delta +R ight)v_u =-2 au \left|\operatorname {Rc}+ abla ^2f- rac{g}{2 au } ight|^2u. \]
Proof

\sketch The displayed evolution identity follows by differentiating the adjoint heat equation and commuting covariant derivatives. Pairing it with a nonnegative solution of the conjugate forward heat equation, the adjoint heat parametrix and the weak maximum principle imply that the pairing tends to zero at $ au =0$ and hence $v_H\le 0$ pointwise.
